lines.zh: 我一扇翅就往前窜出去。
lines.en: One beat of my wings and I shoot forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着低处飞，翅膀刮着草。
lines.en: I fly low with my wings brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 我一边飞一边叫，声音很尖。
lines.en: I shriek as I fly.
I circle this hollow.
I skim over the rocks.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀膜在光里发亮。
lines.en: The membrane of my wings shines in the light.

lines.zh: 我拐得很急，几乎不减速。
lines.en: I turn sharply, barely slowing.
I dive for a stretch.

lines.zh: 我的腿垂着，随时准备抓。
lines.en: My legs hang, ready to grab.
The grass lies down where I pass.

lines.zh: 我挂在石头上，翅膀收着。
lines.en: I cling to the stone with my wings folded.
I open and close my wings slowly.
There's still something on my mouthparts.
I'm listening to the swarm.
My wing pattern looks like bark.
My eyes are set wide apart.
When the swarm goes quiet, I know.

lines.zh: 我的腿轻轻地抓着石头。
lines.en: My legs grip the stone lightly.
My cry knocks between the stone walls.
I turn to hang the other way.
The stone is cold and rough.
There's an odour on me.
I shake the dust off my wings.
I'm counting how many are below.
I fold my wings tighter.
As the light fades, my wings feel lighter.
You're standing at the edge of the hollow.
Both my eyes fix on you at once.
My wings keep moving.
I shrieked and you didn't back away.
Stand still; I am right above you.
I fly a circle around you.

lines.zh: 我的翅影从你额头掠过。
lines.en: My wing shadow sweeps across your brow.
I don't much like the light.

lines.zh: 我们这一群不喜欢生人。
lines.en: My swarm doesn't like strangers.
I drift up half an arm's length.
You track me with your head.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶上停了半息。
lines.en: I hold over your head for half a breath.
I shriek and shoot upward.
One flap drags me to the side.
I've landed on the stone.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一边的翅。
lines.en: That broke one of my wings.
I cling to the stone, wings still quivering.
I fold my wings and shrink down.
I shriek again, weakly.

lines.zh: 我掉了些东西在石头上。
lines.en: I've dropped something on the stone.
I didn't fly far.

lines.zh: 你的气味我记在口器上。
lines.en: I keep your scent on my mouthparts.
Something's crawling below.
I dive that way.
This smell is strong.
I try closing in from its back.
I land and fold my wings.
Too small; gone in one bite.
I've taken it with my legs.
My mouthparts are already grinding.
I hear an answer from far off.
I've torn it open.
I tumble half a turn through the air.
I bolted upward.
My wing got knocked crooked.
Two wingbeats and I steady myself.
I clip you and scream upward.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖刮到你的耳朵。
lines.en: My wingtip grazes your ear.
That knocked some dust off me.
I circled and came back.
We met like two shadows.
I press against the stone and fold my wings.
Another drops down from above.
It calls once; I answer once.
Its shriek matches mine.
Our calls fold into one.
Two pairs of wings folded side by side.
My wing touches its wing.
The swarm gathers below.
We dive one behind the other.
Then it flew off elsewhere.
I stay on the stone.
I take it with my legs.
It's still not quite dead.
I tore a piece off.
I can't bite through this.
I carry it up high.
It slipped from my legs.
I dived and caught it.
I try biting it with my mouthparts.
This thing does not smell of blood.
I let go; it falls into the dark.
There's something below.
I flatten myself and spread my wings.
I descend slowly.
Its head is still down.
I narrow my wings and aim.
One short call is all it takes.
This angle works.
I've put my legs out.
I fold my wings and drop straight down.
It has turned suddenly.
The wind drowns out your steps.
Its shadow covers me.
I cut my cry shorter.
The top of its head is right below me.
Now, while it's open.
I flatten my wings along the stone.
I hear it panting below.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，虫群都动了。
lines.en: I shriek and the swarm stirs.
I'm circling above it.
It goes left; I adjust.
I circle without ever landing.
It stops, so I drift up a little.
I sink down along the rock ledge.
It looks up and I climb at once.
It's running for the deep wood.
I wait for it up ahead.
My shrieking gets more urgent.
Its steps grow more scattered.
It's running for the open.
That way is mine too.
I stoop, then beat upward.
It's panting hard.
I tuck six legs under my belly.
My legs are all spread.
I circle half around above it.

lines.zh: 它抬头找我，我贴得更近。
lines.en: It searches the sky; I press closer.

lines.zh: 我停了一下翅膀，往下落。
lines.en: I stall my wings and drop.
It's running across open ground.
I dive into it.
I seize it with my legs.
My mouthparts bite in.
I tear it open midair.

lines.zh: 它猛地一甩，我掉了下去。
lines.en: It threw me off and I dropped.
I climb again.
That one struck its shoulder.
My wing caught its face.
It's fallen back several steps.
I drop on it a second time.
This time I have it.
My mouthparts clamp on and stay.
At last it goes limp.
I drag it onto the stone.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挣出来，翅膀先张开。
lines.en: I push out of the crack, wings first.
The first shriek is mine.
A shallow hollow surrounds me.
I try one beat of my wings.
I fly up and hit the stone.
I fall back.
My wings are still growing.
There are plenty of insects below.
An echo comes back from the hollow.
I lift off into the air.
I pick a high spot.
I shriek again, a long one.
The swarm stirs below.
Only once my wings dry do I take off.
I spread my wings and test the air.
Wind rises out of the hollow.
I fly toward the sound.
I land and take off again at once.
My shadow sweeps across the stone.

lines.zh: 这一片都是我常飞的地方。
lines.en: This whole hollow is my usual ground.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，我一头栽下去。
lines.en: Fire catches my wings and I drop like a stone.
I hit the ground with my wings spread flat.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的翅膀动不了。
lines.en: Water floods in and my wings won't move.
The blast throws me against the stone.
The arrow hole leaks wind through my wing.
My shriek is stuck in me.
I can't fly; I come down.
The flash whites out my eyes.
I fall, shrieking.
